references.text: Concerns impurity in connection with holy offerings and that the one who is unclean shall not eat of the sacrifice
Prohibition against becoming unclean by contact with the dead, relating to the statement about not giving tithes to the dead
Deals with impurity and holy offerings, stating that the one who is unclean shall not approach the holy offerings
Describes impurity through touching dead bodies, which connects to the prohibition against giving tithes to the dead
Mentions bread of mourning and bread of death, relating to not eating of holy offerings while in mourning or uncleanness
Confirms obedience to the Lord's commands, corresponding with the statement about having obeyed the voice of the Lord
Promise of blessing for listening to the voice of the Lord and doing what is right in his eyes
